rerunRulesCandidate.implementationFailure: Eligible failed primary attempt; no post-oracle repair/retry to improve score. Ordinary autonomous retries within the original active budget count as part of that attempt.
rerunRulesCandidate.timeout: Retain final/partial commits, tracked diff and ignored inventory. Counts as eligible failed primary attempt; no extra active budget by restarting.
rerunRulesCandidate.quota: Checkpoint exact context/commit/index/config and active time; pause inference. Operator may switch account; verify unchanged model/tool controls and record route change before resuming remaining budget. Preserve original attempt and pause duration.
rerunRulesCandidate.infrastructure: Preserve failure; at most one fresh retry after attributable harness/host remediation with identical task/model/tool controls. Report primary intention-to-treat outcome and separate successful-completion sensitivity; never replace a failure silently.
rerunRulesCandidate.harnessDefect: If controls or acceptance must change, invalidate affected pilot/cell evidence explicitly; correct and version controls before any replacement. No arm-specific waiver.
rerunRulesCandidate.unsupportedIntegration: Keep original matrix cell/ordinal with evidence and null unavailable usage. No substitute backend or invented integration.
rerunRulesCandidate.pilot: Pilot results do not count; scored inclusion requires a fresh run after harness/control freeze.

outcomeRulesCandidate.passing: Frozen task gates and package gates plus full exact-final-commit Yeet exit0; clean reconstructed commit and bound controls/receipts required.
outcomeRulesCandidate.review: Deterministic failures cannot be waived by human/model grades. Tool/model labels hidden from fresh judges where practical; file/diff rationale, anchored1-5 separate dimensions and low/medium/high certainty.
outcomeRulesCandidate.unknown: Missing usage/line/path/adoption/billing remains null with cause, never zero.
outcomeRulesCandidate.selection: Passing correctness and quality/reuse first; time/tokens/setup/upkeep next, within model/task. All failures and unknowns retained.
outcomeRulesCandidate.acceptanceFeedback: Sealed acceptance executes only after coding completion; private suite/oracle/report never returned to coding agent for a retry.
outcomeRulesCandidate.publication: Trial agents commit locally only; winner PR remediation happens after selection and is reported separately from frozen trial outcome.

candidateSourceGate.supplementalFullScope: failed inherited four coverage metrics; all other lanes passed

ordinaryVerificationBoundaryCandidate.rule: All arms retain the same ordinary repository checks. A canonical check may internally invoke a structural analyzer (for example the lockfile-pinned Fallow quality lane), independent of the separately pinned navigation treatment.
ordinaryVerificationBoundaryCandidate.restriction: Coding agents may not invoke another graph configuration for navigation. Normal verification command output is available identically within a model/task; do not introduce arm-specific quality shortcuts.
ordinaryVerificationBoundaryCandidate.measurement: Keep ordinary verification subprocesses and post-coding evaluator work separate from model-selected graph adoption. The repository quality analyzer version and assigned graph-tool version can differ and must both remain bound to their own frozen input inventories.
